definitions.model_turn: One bounded Chat API request; never an execution grant.
definitions.tool_exchange: One complete assistant tool call and its matching ARE result.
definitions.recycle: Begin a fresh provider message history from bounded task state and archived evidence.

product_prototype: A local coding agent that inspects allowlisted source and proposes one verifiable patch using GLM-5.3-Flash.

business_prototype.purpose: Make ARE usable with a funded model-specific API bundle.
business_prototype.value_hypothesis: Reuse of ARE controls reduces integration and recovery effort.

domainspec_prototype.effects: proposal only; isolated canary applies to a disposable copy
domainspec_prototype.token_measurement: provider tokenizer, exact messages and tools, plus explicit margin; verify usage after response

open_questions: Provider tokenizer coverage across complex native histories must be checked against live usage.
